edits.content:
# Action-driven beginner guide

The HUD presents one next lesson. Guide opens the full reference.
Eighteen lessons cover movement, interaction, equipment, attack, abilities, loot, skill XP, gathering, crafting, shops, map, quests, service interiors, recovery, and the road onward.
No developer grants or forced death are used.

The authoritative server records gameplay milestones after accepted actions or real simulated movement.
Milestones serialize with each character. Missing fields in older saves default to empty.
Invented completion commands are rejected. Tutorials grant no currency or items.
Inventory, Map, and recovery-help views are local per-character preferences. They do not alter server action sequences.
A different device can show these three informational hints again.

Minimize the objective tracker or disable tutorial hints from Guide.
This is not evidence of the full new-player playthrough. Early pacing, all-class instruction, scaling, and village art remain separate acceptance checks.
